prompt: A casual conversation about the Apollo moon landing. Topics: NASA, astronauts, lunar surface, kangaroo hop, splashdown, ticker-tape parade in New York.
text: It was rather interesting just to watch them gathering their materials and bouncing around their, what they call it, kangaroo walk or something like that. Who named it that? I don't know. I bet those men are going to get quite a reception when they get back to Earth. Yes, I'll be so glad when they land back now, but I think that's pretty well a fact because they've landed so many safely now.
